description: This Kotlin source file defines a Fragment named PlayerFragment that manages video playback using ExoPlayer and the Media3 library. It handles player initialization, release, and user input for media control within an Android TV or similar application.

classes.name: PlayerFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that handles video playback with ExoPlayer, including UI setup, media management, and key event handling for media controls.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, initializes the PlayerView, and sets up key event handling for remote control actions.

methods.name: buildMediaItem
methods.description: Constructs a MediaItem for ExoPlayer based on the media URL and content type inferred from its extension.

methods.name: initializePlayer
methods.description: Creates and configures the ExoPlayer instance if it isn't already initialized, sets the media item, and starts playback.

methods.name: releasePlayer
methods.description: Releases the ExoPlayer resources and clears the PlayerView's player reference.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Lifecycle method; initializes the player on API level 24+.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Lifecycle method; initializes the player on API levels below 24.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Lifecycle method; releases the player on API levels below 24.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Lifecycle method; releases the player on API level 24 and above.
